name: Amazing Grace
plainLyrics:
Amazing Grace
How sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me
Oh, I once was lost, but now
I'm found, was blind, but now I see

There's grace that taught my heart to fear
Grace my fears relieved
How precious did that grace appear
The hour I first believed
Yeah, when we've been there ten thousand years
Bright shining as the sun
We've no less days to sing God's praise
Then when we first began

Oh, Amazing Grace
How sweet the sound
Saved a wretch like me
Oh, I once was lost, but now
I'm found, was blind, but now I see
Ooh, I was blind, but now I see

Woah, woah-oh-oh
Amen
